digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and DET overlay gate
propositions: T3 and T10 criteria have never blocked across ~2500 runs due to a configuration artifact, not low quality.
Enable blocking for T3 and T10 by setting default_posture blocking with block_threshold 0.90 in criteria_routing.json.
Scope T10 blocking to MAJOR classes via a severity-guidance sentence in plan_review_T10.md rather than a new per-class mechanism.
Add a T10 infra DET overlay gate as a DetGateRule matching IaC/GHA trigger vocabulary in det_gate_rules.py.
Update both pinned assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py to reflect the T3/T10 posture and blocking-set changes.
Regenerate docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md to reflect the new blocking configuration.
